body:
Maya (Sales): Quick help — BetaCorp POC is getting 413 when POSTing their full chat logs. They say payload ~11.8MB. Console shows HTTP/1.1 413. Any immediate triage steps?
Carlos (SE): 413 = request entity too large from gateway. Ask which endpoint/region and request sample (sanitized). Also ask if they can gzip or upload.
Maya (Sales): Theyre on hosted eu-west. Paste from their client:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  --data-binary @session.json

< HTTP/1.1 413 Request Entity Too Large
{"error":"request too large","code":"PayloadTooLarge"}
```
Jamal (Support): That matches our edge limit. We enforce ~10MB on hosted gateways to protect backends.
Liu (Platform Eng): Confirmed: eu-west gateway limit is 10,485,760 bytes. For larger payloads we recommend upload+reference or chunking.
Sara (Solutions): If they need fidelity for the POC, presigned upload is least intrusive: they PUT the full JSON to S3 (via our presigned URL) then call /v1/generate with a pointer. We already support this flow.
Carlos (SE): Example flow to share: 1) POST /v1/upload (returns upload_id + presigned_url) 2) PUT file to presigned_url 3) POST /v1/generate {"transcript_ref":"upload:upload_id","window":50} 
Maya (Sales): Customer asks if we can "just raise the limit" for a few days for the POC. Is that possible?
Priya (Eng Oncall): Not on hosted prod without infra changes. Options:
- Short: use /v1/upload or chunking (no infra change)
- Short-ish: provision Dedicated POC with higher ingress (takes 2-4 business days)
- Investigate temporary bypass but requires infra & security signoff — not immediate
I'll open a ticket to check bypass feasibility.
Jamal (Support): Note: gzip on the client helps only for upload endpoint; /v1/generate still hits gateway limit. Transfer-Encoding: chunked won't bypass the configured limit.
Liu (Platform Eng): Also warn them about token windows — even if we accept the bytes, models cap tokens (e.g., 16k/32k). If the transcript maps to more tokens, they'll need long-context model or rolling summaries. Ask which model they're using.
Maya (Sales): BetaCorp insisted on end-to-end fidelity for demos. If we offer Dedicated POC, what's rough cost/lead time?
Sara (Solutions): Ballpark: Dedicated POC with increased ingress and a small reserved GPU pool — internal estimate ~$1k–2k/day depending on GPU. Lead time ~48–96 hours for provisioning + approvals. SalesOps can firm numbers.
Priya (Eng Oncall): Created ticket INF-4412 to collect gateway logs and approvals. Jamal/Carlos please attach sanitized request and the client IP + request_len.
Carlos (SE): Also recommend a quick client-side alternative to avoid blocking demo: upload transcript to their own S3 and send a trimmed request that asks the model to fetch or summarize the object (if they can host). That avoids presigned flow if they prefer self-hosting.
Maya (Sales): I'll present three options to BetaCorp: 1) upload+pointer (fast), 2) chunk & stitch (engineering effort), 3) Dedicated POC bump (sales + ops). Linking INF-4412.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4412 created by Priya (Eng Oncall)
